column1: # The bundled ICC colour profiles, one row per shipped profile.
# `description` is the ICC profile description string and is the ONLY name any
# caller may use for a bundled profile: the distribution agreement requires
# every individual profile to be referenced by that string, and the engine
# resolves by it (src/engine/icc_profiles.py) by reading each shipped
# profile's own `desc` tag. The file name on disk is the upstream member's
# base name and carries no meaning — nothing may key off it.
# `condition` is the profile's own `targ` (characterizationTarget) tag content,
# empty when the profile declares none. It is the ONLY source for a PDF/X
# /OutputConditionIdentifier that claims a registered characterization; a
# profile with an empty condition is identified by its description string
# instead, because a registry name it does not declare would be invented.
# `copyright` is the profile's own `cprt` tag, reproduced here so a row cannot
# be added for a profile whose copyright notice nobody read. The notice gate in
# scripts/bundle-icc.ps1 refuses to write the resource tree when a row is
# incomplete or when the shipped end-user licence text is missing.
# Regenerate the sha256 column with: scripts\bundle-icc.ps1 -WriteManifest
